lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice inferring attitude from indirect language and tone.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Understanding whether a friend sounds enthusiastic, hesitant, or disappointed about a plan.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Interpreting implied attitude and checking it politely.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a travel plan where the reaction sounds polite but not fully enthusiastic.

main_focus.name: attitude inference with det verkar som att
main_focus.description: Use verkar som att and låter som att to describe an implied attitude without claiming certainty.
model_examples: Det verkar som att hon är lite tveksam.
Det låter som att planen inte passar helt.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use attitude-inference phrases naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

avoid_grammar: sarcasm as the main listening task

useful_chunks: Vi borde nog fråga på ett tydligt sätt.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use attitude words carefully, with hedging to avoid overclaiming.

dialogue_shape.opening: A polite but ambiguous reaction to a plan is introduced.
dialogue_shape.middle: They infer possible hesitation or disappointment, cite clues in wording, and decide how to clarify.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on a polite clarification question.

target_complexity.repetition: inference phrases should be repeated with different attitude words

sentence_focus: one sentence with det verkar som att
one sentence with det låter som att
one sentence saying how something is interpreted
one sentence proposing a polite clarification question
